titleEn: Royal Decree No.436 on Establishment of "Techo Sen Russey Treb Cambodian Royal Academy Park"

articles.en: The “Techo Sen Russey Treb Cambodian Royal Academy Park” is hereby established as a national park in the fields of archaeology, history, culture and nature, with the aim of ensuring the sustainability of archaeological research and protecting the national heritage, the environment and the natural resources of the area according to the actual geography.

This Royal Decree has the following objectives: - to conserve the cultural heritage of the ancient iron industry of Russey Treb, including in the fields of archaeology, ethnology, history, ecology and botany, in order to enhance the value of the national park conservation area and to protect it still further; - to conserve the ancient iron industrial site and develop it into a cultural, historical and natural tourism area.

The “Techo Sen Russey Treb Cambodian Royal Academy Park” shall be managed, maintained and protected in accordance with the specific levels of significance in the fields of archaeology, ethnology, history, environment and nature, respecting the ownership rights of the citizens living in the entire area as regards their livelihood, and protecting it so that its value is further enhanced.
The Cambodian Royal Academy of the Office of the Council of Ministers shall be exclusively responsible for managing all [matters] in order to fulfil these missions; the Royal Academy of Cambodia shall have the right [illegible]; May 2014, Royal Kram No. 4029; the rules and procedures for the management, conservation, maintenance and protection of the Techo Sen Russey Treb Cambodian Royal Academy Park shall be determined by sub-decree.
Any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
Done at the Royal Palace, 05 [month illegible] 2014.
Royal signature and seal, Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, signature, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen; respectfully submitted to Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister; Deputy Prime Minister
